translated_title: Ecobici Increases Its Fleet by 60%: It Will Reach the Outskirts, Brugada Announces
original_title: Ecobici incrementa 60% su parque: llegará a las periferias, anuncia Brugada
author: Darren García
meta_description: The 10-year contract runs up to 2.43 billion pesos, brings bike-share to Iztapalapa, Iztacalco and Tlalpan for the first time, and hands all the infrastructure to the city at term's end.
